scope: Join all returned mkdir/transfer callback promises after the first failure, stop scheduling further callbacks, then reject with the original first error. Only extractArchive uses this local pool.
limitations: Prepared source only; no installed host, full application build/typecheck or native acceptance.
Joining callback promises does not prove extractor/child exit, independent native I/O completion or host-global idle.
A callback that never settles keeps the transfer held; no timeout, forced cancellation or ownership release is added.
Existing remove-before-copy, overwrite defaults, missing-source warnings and failure cleanup remain separate no-clobber and ownership gates.
The global mapWithConcurrency helper and dependency/cancellation consumers retain their existing behavior.
